{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Tumor imaging only at screening, no on-treatment assessments",
      "quote": "Tumor imaging (including brain imaging) | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "Tumor imaging is only performed at screening, with no on-treatment tumor assessments scheduled. This is insufficient for an oncology trial where response assessment is critical.",
      "fix": "Add tumor imaging at specified intervals (e.g., every 6-8 weeks) and at end of treatment."
    },
    {
      "title": "Coagulation only at screening and EOT, missing on-treatment monitoring",
      "quote": "Coagulation: PT, INR, and aPTT | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Coagulation is only assessed at screening and end of treatment, with no on-treatment monitoring. This is a safety concern, especially if the study drug affects coagulation.",
      "fix": "Add coagulation assessments at regular intervals during treatment (e.g., each cycle)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Urinalysis only at screening, Cycle 1, and EOT",
      "quote": "Urinalysis | X | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Urinalysis is only performed at screening, Cycle 1, and EOT. This may miss treatment-emergent renal toxicity.",
      "fix": "Consider adding urinalysis at regular intervals (e.g., every cycle or every other cycle)."
    },
    {
      "title": "12-Lead ECG frequency inconsistent and sparse",
      "quote": "12-Lead ECG | X | X |  |  |  | X |  | X | X | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "ECG is performed at screening, Cycle 1, Cycle 5, then Cycles 7-17 and beyond, but not at Cycles 2-4 or 6. This inconsistent frequency may miss cardiac safety signals and is not aligned with typical oncology monitoring.",
      "fix": "Standardize ECG assessments (e.g., every cycle or at specified intervals) and ensure adequate coverage."
    },
    {
      "title": "Screening window of 28 days is long and may delay treatment",
      "quote": "Screening Days -28 to -1 (Day -28)",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "A 28-day screening window is long and may delay treatment initiation, increasing patient burden and risk of disease progression.",
      "fix": "Consider shortening the screening window to 21 days or less, if feasible."
    },
    {
      "title": "EOT visit within 14 days after final dose may be too long",
      "quote": "Discon. Visit (EOT) Within 14 Days after Final Dose",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "A 14-day window for the end-of-treatment visit is long and may delay safety assessments and transition to follow-up.",
      "fix": "Shorten the EOT window to 7 days or less, if possible."
    },
    {
      "title": "Safety Follow-Up at 30 days may be insufficient for late-onset toxicities",
      "quote": "Safety Follow-Up Approx. 30 Days after Final Dose",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "advisory",
      "severity": "advisory",
      "explanation": "A 30-day safety follow-up may be insufficient to capture late-onset toxicities, especially for agents with long half-lives or delayed effects.",
      "fix": "Consider extending safety follow-up to 60 or 90 days, or until resolution of AEs."
    },
    {
      "title": "No tumor imaging at baseline for all patients?",
      "quote": "Tumor imaging (including brain imaging) | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Tumor imaging is only listed at screening, but it is unclear if this is a baseline assessment. If not, there is no baseline tumor measurement for response evaluation.",
      "fix": "Clarify that tumor imaging at screening serves as baseline and add on-treatment assessments."
    }
  ]
}
